verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a virtual mailbox service, so webhooks or Zapier triggers for new-mail and scan-complete events are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence only documents manual app and web portal management (view, scan requests, forwarding, shredding). Nothing mentions webhooks, Zapier, or any API, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I get webhooks (or at least Zapier triggers) when new mail arrives or a scan completes, so downstream automation starts without polling
